transcript: They expanded the list of specialty crops that CFAP applies to, which is what we continue to bang on them. And then third, actually I got a fourth too, third, going forward producers who apply for CPAP will get 100% of their total payment, which is pretty good not to exceed their payment limit. And then fourth, we got words that the deadline to apply for CPAP, the Coronavirus Food Assistance Program, has been extended from August 28 to September 11, 2020. So I wanted to start off with positive because I'm a positive guy and I like to do that, but there have been improvements that have been made, have been needed, and we've continued to push the USDA to make these types of improvements. I want to start off with that good news because I think that's deserved because although at first it just like a lot of things in this pandemic especially when it comes to some of these relief packages the intent is good behind them but there's a lot of bumps in the roads to get to good and we've got over some bumps with the CPAP we're getting to good but it takes some constant push in this position with the USDA and I'm more than happy to do that because that's my job. So that USDA has that data and can get this information out there and get this funding out there. And as we're seeing based on the announcement, we're getting there. And so I'll just leave it at that in that we're seeing the CPAP get out there slowly, but surely how's that?
